title: Evicted pod logs
description: Why pods went away (events and pod terminal states) next to the last lines they logged.

panels.title: Kubelet evictions per namespace
panels.description: Evicted events come from the kubelet (node pressure, ephemeral-storage limits). Eviction-API evictions (drain, cluster-autoscaler, Karpenter) emit no Evicted event; the pod terminal state panel shows those as disruption=EvictionByEvictionAPI.

panels.title: Eviction and termination events
panels.description: Evicted = kubelet eviction. Killing without Evicted = API deletion or eviction. Preempted / TaintManagerEviction = scheduler and taint evictions.

panels.title: Last lines of $pod in $namespace
panels.description: Newest first. pod and pod_uid are structured metadata on every line; filter on pod_uid to tell apart StatefulSet pods that reused a name.

panels.title: Pod terminal state (pod-lifecycle)
panels.description: From the pod-lifecycle watcher, independent of log files. disruption = EvictionByEvictionAPI | TerminationByKubelet | PreemptionByScheduler | DeletionByTaintManager. 'last lines' is the container termination message (FallbackToLogsOnError), which survives when the log file does not.

targets.expr: {cluster="$cluster", namespace="__AGENTS_NAMESPACE__", container="watch"} | json pod_name="pod", ns="namespace", lifecycle="lifecycle", phase="phase", reason="reason", msg="message", disruption="disruption.reason", last="containers[0].lastLines" | ns="$namespace" | pod_name=~"$pod" | phase="Failed" or lifecycle="DELETED" | line_format "{{.lifecycle}} {{.pod_name}} phase={{.phase}} reason={{.reason}} disruption={{.disruption}} {{.msg}} | last lines: {{.last}}"
